message.content:
<summary>
Turn 16: Agent inspected failing command 018 (“Fly from (0,0,1) to (0,2,1) in 2.1 seconds”). Loaded planned vs actual trajectories and found persistent final position error ~0.081 m; actual ended at y≈2.080, z≈0.988. Gains used were kp_pos=[5.2,5.2,10.4], ki_pos=[0,0,0.65], kd_pos=[3.9,3.9,6.5], kp_att=[286,286,156], kd_att=[45.5,45.5,26].
Turn 17: Opened simulate.py; noted position_controller outputs F_cmd and acc_cmd, then attitude_planner produces desired roll/pitch, attitude_controller gives moments, motor_model maps F_cmd/M_cmd to rpm; thrust is applied without explicit tilt compensation.
Turn 18–20: Attempted edit failed due to mismatch (Turn 18), then correctly inserted “tilt thrust compensation” in simulate.py (Turn 20): recomputed F_cmd = m*(g+acc_cmd[2])/(cos(phi_des)cos(theta_des)) after attitude_planner to avoid z sag during lateral motion.
Turn 21–22: Regenerated all results and revalidated; only command 018 still failed (ok_acc True, but ok_pos False and ok_metrics False). Max error reduced slightly to ~0.0795 m; SteadyStateError ~0.0792 m, Overshoot ~3.96%.
Turn 23–25: Further inspected 018: final actual position y≈2.079, z≈1.0049; y error stayed about +0.079 m at the end and had already exceeded 0.05 m early (first index >0.05 at k=148, ~0.74 s). Error ranged roughly [-0.00028, +0.0794], indicating a sustained lateral bias rather than transient overshoot.
Turn 26–27: Reviewed attitude_planner.py (previously small-angle linear mapping roll/pitch from ax, ay / g). Replaced it with a geometric-style planner: computes desired body z-axis b3 from (acc_des + g*e3), constructs rotation matrix from yaw and b3, then extracts ZYX Euler angles.
Turn 28–29: Updated simulate.py thrust logic again: removed the earlier cos(phi)cos(theta) compensation and instead computed thrust magnitude as F_cmd = m*||acc_cmd + [0,0,g]|| (and renamed the unused original position_controller thrust output to _F_cmd). attitude_planner now uses the same gravity value.
Turn 30: Regenerated /root/results for all commands with the updated attitude planner and thrust computation; no post-regeneration validation was run yet in this chunk.</summary>
